notes: Read both units, full women and global-policy context, all nineteen candidates and the review. Resolved Trump's conduct and normalized the international-standing metaphor; named U.S. alliances, domestic scope and diplomats; retained the proposed second-term frame across every Biden commitment; kept multilateral mechanisms attached to poverty, debt and global-economy goals; and dated the refugee comparison while preserving near-destruction as characterization. Restored the autocracy-pretext allegation and general humanitarian-assistance expansion.

claims.claim_text: Trump's attacks on democratic institutions and press freedom and rejection of the 2020 result are said to have damaged U.S. international standing.
That conduct is said to have given autocracies a pretext to dismiss democratic values and practices.
In a proposed second term, President Biden would not abandon U.S. alliances.
In a proposed second term, Biden would defend human rights and democracy abroad and in the United States.
In a proposed second term, Biden would support U.S. diplomats' work.
In a proposed second term, Biden would strengthen global health systems.
In a proposed second term, Biden would bolster pandemic-preparedness programs.
In a proposed second term, Biden would alleviate global food insecurity.
Biden would expand U.S. humanitarian assistance to people in greatest need.
The 2024 target of resettling 100,000 refugees is described as the largest in three decades after Trump nearly destroyed, in the platform's characterization, the U.S. Refugee Admissions Program.
In a proposed second term, Biden would have the United States drive multilateral poverty-reduction efforts.
In a proposed second term, Biden would have the United States drive multilateral efforts addressing unsustainable debt burdens.
In a proposed second term, Biden would have the United States drive multilateral efforts to build a more inclusive and fairer global economy.
In a proposed second term, Biden would continue leading efforts against climate change, characterized as an existential threat.
In a proposed second term, Biden would support climate-adaptation efforts in developing nations.
In a proposed second term, Biden would keep fighting corruption.
In a proposed second term, Biden would support good governance.
In a proposed second term, Biden would counter terrorist threats worldwide.
